author: 莫泊桑
quote_zh: 生活不可能像你想象得那么好，但也不会像你想象得那么糟。 我觉得人的脆弱和坚强都超乎自己的想象。 有时，我可能脆弱得一句话就泪流满面；有时，也发现自己咬着牙走了很长的路。
quote_en: Life can't be as good as you think it is, but it can't be as bad as you think it is. I feel that people are fragile and strong beyond their imagination. Sometimes, I may be so fragile that I burst into tears with a single word; sometimes, I also find myself gritting my teeth and walking a long way.

author: 人间失格
quote_zh: 怎样都好，只要能让他们发笑就好。
quote_en: No matter what, as long as it makes them laugh.

author: 火影忍者
quote_zh: 现在我这个遗患，已经成为把真学们极欲拔掉的夫来比道中钉。
quote_en: Now that I am a bereaved victim, I have become the husband who wants to pull out the true scholars.

author: 吕小布
quote_zh: 生活，就是生出来活下去，其它都是浮云，活的潇洒一点。
quote_en: Life, is to be born to live, the rest are floating clouds, live a little dashing.

author: 每日一习话
quote_zh: 出入相友，守望相助。
quote_en: Go out and befriend each other and help each other.

author: 佚名
quote_zh: 不努力就只能听到别人的好消息。
quote_en: If you don't work hard, you will only hear good news from others.

author: 柳宗元
quote_zh: 千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。
quote_en: Over a thousand hills, no bird's in flight,On myriads paths, not one foot-print in sight.

author: 周佳顺
quote_zh: 如果你在看，我就是你的风景。如果你在听，我该有多幸运。
quote_en: If you are looking, I am your scenery. How lucky I am if you are listening.

author: ccdalao
quote_zh: 等一条离群太远的深海游鱼 碰到一只 离群太远的蚁
quote_en: When a deep-sea swimming fish that is too far away from the herd encounters an ant that is too far away from the herd

author: 少女终末旅行
quote_zh: 和绝望，和睦相处
quote_en: and despair, harmony.

author: 兰德
quote_zh: 我和谁都不争，和谁争我都不屑。我的双手烤着生命之火取暖，火萎了，我也准备走了。
quote_en: I don't argue with anyone, and I don't disdain to argue with anyone. My hands were warmed by the flame of life, the flame withered, and I was ready to leave.

author: 某不知名OIer
quote_zh: 十年OI一场空，不开longlong见祖宗。
quote_en: Ten years of OI was empty, not opening longlong to see the ancestors.

author: 红玫瑰和白玫瑰
quote_zh: 冲动的红色终究是败在了白玫瑰的平淡和冷静上，狠狠的跌了一个大跟头，看着更加刺眼。
quote_en: After all, the impulsive red was defeated by the plainness and calmness of the white rose, and fell fiercely to a big heel, looking even more dazzling.

author: 原创
quote_zh: 真正珍惜时间的人不会找任何借口……可惜我不是。
quote_en: People who really cherish time don't make any excuses... but I'm not.

author: 冰与火之歌
quote_zh: 很多人宁可否认事实，也不愿面对真相。
quote_en: Many people would rather deny the truth than face the truth.

author: Fate / Grand Order
quote_zh: 于此——聆听吧！汝之晚钟已然敲响！
quote_en: Here - listen! The clock of Thy evening has struck!

author: 李白
quote_zh: 日色欲尽花含烟，月明欲素愁不眠。
quote_en: The sun is full of flowers and smoke, and the moon is full of sleeplessness.

author: 三体
quote_zh: 大多数人到死都没有向尘世之外瞥一眼。
quote_en: Most people die without glancing out of the world.

author: 肯尼·阿克曼
quote_zh: 人找不到某种东西沉迷就活不下来。人都是某种东西的奴隶。
quote_en: People can't survive if they can't find something to indulge in. Man is a slave to something.

author: miHoYo
quote_zh: 愿所有的美好都能得到祝福。
quote_en: May all good things be blessed.

author: 佚名
quote_zh: 等到功成名就的一天，日月山川都来祝贺。
quote_en: After a successful day, the sun, moon, and mountains came to congratulate him.

author: 大王饶命
quote_zh: 有朋自远方来，必先苦其心志，劳其筋骨，饿其体肤，空乏其身，行拂乱其所为。然后鞭数十，逐之别庭。孔子曰：不亦说乎。
quote_en: When a friend comes from far away, he must first struggle with his heart, work hard, starve his body, lack his body, and confuse his actions. Then he whipped dozens of people and chased them away from the court. Confucius said: Not really.

author: 褚嬴
quote_zh: 当你真正想做成一件事情的时候，就连天地万物都会帮你。
quote_en: When you really want to do something, even the heavens and the earth will help you.

author: 罗密欧与朱丽叶
quote_zh: 维罗纳的夏天找不到这样一朵好花。
quote_en: You can't find such a good flower in the summer in Verona.

author: 老番茄
quote_zh: 每个人藏在影子里的，才是他真实的那面。
quote_en: What everyone hides in the shadow is his true side.

author: 火影忍者
quote_zh: 所谓爱情，是对对自己最重要的人，以慈悲的心保护他的想法。
quote_en: Love is the idea of protecting the person who is most important to you with a compassionate heart.

author: 弱智吧
quote_zh: 这个世界对于笑话来讲是很残酷的，如果不好笑，它甚至活不到下一张嘴。
quote_en: The world is cruel to a joke, and if it's not funny, it won't even live to see its next mouth.

author: 旋土浮尘
quote_zh: 流萤漫天花共舞，闲蝉栖柳风奏湖。十年一梦不觉醒，夏祭花火终成空。
quote_en: Flowing fireflies danced with smallpox, and leisurely cicadas perched on the willow wind playing lake. Ten years and a dream did not awaken, and the summer festival fireworks were completely empty.

author: Az殇芯的chx
quote_zh: 我从未让你们骄傲，你们却待我如宝。
quote_en: I have never made you proud, yet you have treated me like a treasure.

author: 柯钊
quote_zh: 一辈子，能坚持做好一件事就很伟大了！
quote_en: It's great to be able to do one thing well for the rest of your life!

author: 暗黑
quote_zh: 痛苦犹如一艘船，欲望是指南针。
quote_en: Pain is like a ship, desire is the compass.

author: 贴吧
quote_zh: 你可不是什么普通女孩，你是我的女孩。
quote_en: You're no ordinary girl, you're my girl.

author: 天野远子
quote_zh: 无论多么痛苦，都要把故事的书页翻下去；总有一天，能够到达可以看到满天繁星的地方。
quote_en: No matter how painful, turn down the pages of the story; someday, you will reach a place where you can see the stars.

author: 佚名
quote_zh: 人在年轻时，不该遇到太惊艳的人。
quote_en: People should not meet too amazing people when they are young.

author: 某个Dr.
quote_zh: 只去看沿途的风景而不关注道路的末尾，就很有可能在终点前掉到坑里。
quote_en: If you only look at the scenery along the way and don't pay attention to the end of the road, you are likely to fall into the pit before the end.

quote_zh: 陆上的人喜欢寻根问底，虚度了大好光阴，冬天忧虑夏天的姗姗来迟，夏天忧虑冬天的将至，所以他们不停四处游走，追求一个遥不可及的四季如夏的地方，然而我并不羡慕。
quote_en: People on land like to look for the roots and spend a lot of time in vain. I am worried that winter is late and summer is late, and summer is worried about the coming of winter. Therefore, they are constantly walking around and pursuing a place like summer in four seasons that is out of reach. However, I am not envious.

author: 佚名
quote_zh: 山无陵，江水为竭。冬雷震震，夏雨雪。天地合，乃敢与君绝。
quote_en: There is no mausoleum in the mountain, and the river is exhausted. Winter thunder shook, summer rain and snow. The heavens and the earth are united, but they dare to break with the king.

author: 叔本华
quote_zh: 青年时期，他们觉得人群遗弃了自己；成年之后，却觉得自己逃离了人群。
quote_en: In their youth, they felt that the crowd had abandoned them; in adulthood, they felt that they had fled the crowd.

author: 约会大作战
quote_zh: 让我们开始我们的约会（战争）吧
quote_en: Let's start our date (war)

author: 守望先锋
quote_zh: 勇气并非来自体力，而是来自不屈不挠的意志。
quote_en: Courage does not come from physical strength, but from indomitable will.

author: 天下归元
quote_zh: 这一番乱哄哄你争我杀，到头来换了什么？不过是半樽薄酒，一身落拓，数曲残琴，满鬓风霜。
quote_en: This chaos coaxed you to fight for me to kill, in the end, what did you change? It was just a half-barrel of thin wine, all dressed up, a few pieces of residual piano, and full of wind and frost.

author: 田所浩二
quote_zh: 逸一时，误一世。
quote_en: Yi Yi was lost for a while and lost his life.

author: 刘慈欣
quote_zh: “青铜时代”呼叫“蓝色空间”！“青铜时代”呼叫“蓝色空间”！不要返航，这里不是家！
quote_en: "Bronze Age" to "Blue Space"! "Bronze Age" to "Blue Space"! Don't go back, this is not your home!

author: 茶渡泰虎
quote_zh: 如果我不握着剑，我就无法保护你，如果我总握着剑，我就无法抱紧你。
quote_en: If I don't hold the sword, I can't protect you, if I always hold the sword, I can't hold you tight.

author: Coconut Studio
quote_zh: 不会用怎么办？首先不要慌张，打开文档看看。
quote_en: What if I don't use it? First of all, don't panic, open the document and look at it.

author: 网易云
quote_zh: 等到梅子黄时，我再为你落最后一次笔，写你眼里泅泳的鲸和脚踝的痣。
quote_en: When the plums are yellow, I will drop the last pen for you and write the whale and ankle mole in your eyes.

author: 沐风
quote_zh: 博文天下，遍理人间！
quote_en: Under the world of Bowen, all over the world!

author: 姬宫伊织
quote_zh: 我的恋爱还没有开始就结束了。
quote_en: My love affair ended before it even started.

author: 法斯
quote_zh: 越想贴近事实，不明白的事情就越多。
quote_en: The more you want to get close to the facts, the more you don't understand.

author: 魔兽世界
quote_zh: 大地母亲在忽悠着你。
quote_en: Mother Earth is leaning on you.

author: The New Order:Last Days of Europe
quote_zh: 时间的意义取决于人类：千年如一日，一日复千年。
quote_en: The meaning of time depends on mankind: millennia are days, days are millennia.

author: 东方永夜抄 ～ Imperishable Night.
quote_zh: 真正的恐怖，存在于约定俗成的恐怖之外。
quote_en: The real horror lies beyond the conventional horror.

author: 雪乃纱衣
quote_zh: 明明喜欢的不得了，可是看到对方幸福洋溢的表情，却觉得很难过、很痛苦，胸口发疼。
quote_en: I obviously liked it, but when I saw the other person's happy expression, I felt very sad, very painful, and my chest hurt.

author: Sodium_Sulfate
quote_zh: 没有BUG的代码是不完美的！
quote_en: Code without bugs is not perfect!

author: 终末之诗
quote_zh: 宇宙说：你所斗争的黑暗就在你心中，你所寻找的光明就在你心中。
quote_en: The universe says: The darkness you struggle against is in your heart, and the light you seek is in your heart.

author: 陈铭
quote_zh: 爱情不是一个拼图，是一个圆碰到另一个圆。
quote_en: Love is not a puzzle, it is a circle that touches another circle.

author: 终极恶女
quote_zh: 无能为力的同情比欺负本身更伤人。
quote_en: Impotent sympathy hurts more than bullying itself.

author: 火影忍者
quote_zh: 人啊...想要保护重要东西的时候，就真的能变得很坚强。
quote_en: People... when you want to protect something important, you can really be strong.

author: 原创
quote_zh: 有一些情感，没办法辜负它。
quote_en: There are some emotions that you can't live up to.

author: 陆游
quote_zh: 呜呼！楚虽三户能亡秦，岂有堂堂中国空无人！
quote_en: Woohoo! Although Chu's three households could die in Qin, there was no one in China!

author: 画中人
quote_zh: 天有烘炉，地生五金，晖冶寒萃照云清。星藏点雪，月隐晦明，拙山枯水大江行。
quote_en: There is an oven in the sky, the ground produces hardware, and the Hui Yehan extracts the clouds. The stars hid some snow, the moon was obscure, and the withered mountains and rivers were on their way.

author: 一个无归期的人
quote_zh: 你的世界，我进不去。我的未来，你也不必参与。
quote_en: I can't get into your world. My future, you don't have to be a part of it.

author: Thomas Edison
quote_en: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
quote_zh: 天才是百分之一的灵感和百分之九十九的汗水。

author: Lao Tzu
quote_en: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
quote_zh: 千里之行，始于足下。

author: Abraham Lincoln
quote_en: A house divided against itself cannot stand.
quote_zh: 有内讧的家不能存在；家和万事兴。

author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quote_en: Difficulties increase the nearer we get to the goal.
quote_zh: 我们越接近目标，困难就越大。

author: Byron Pulsifer
quote_en: Fate is in your hands and no one elses
quote_zh: 命运掌握在你手中，没有其他人

author: Yogi Berra
quote_en: You can observe a lot just by watching.
quote_zh: 您可以通过观看来观察很多。
